meta.name: azure-kubernetes
meta.description: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters. Covers Day-0 checklist, SKU selection (Automatic vs Standard), networking options (private API server, Azure CNI Overlay, egress configuration), security, and operations (autoscaling, upgrade strategy, cost analysis). WHEN: create AKS environment, provision AKS, enable AKS observability, design AKS networking, choose AKS SKU, secure AKS, optimize AKS, AKS spot nodes, AKS cluster-autoscaler, rightsize AKS pod, pod rightsizing, over-provisioned AKS pod, pod resource requests and limits, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, VPA recommendations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划、创建并配置生产就绪的 AKS 集群。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正计划在 Azure 上搭建生产级 Kubernetes 集群。
copy.tagline_en: Plan, create, and configure production-ready Azure Kubernetes clusters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning to set up production-grade Kubernetes clusters on Azure.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的需求输出一套 AKS 集群的推荐配置，区分「建集群时就要定死」的 Day-0 决策（网络、API server）和之后可开启的 Day-1 功能，覆盖选 SKU、网络、安全、监控、升级、成本等。
howto.when: 当你想新建 AKS 集群、规划生产配置、设计网络，或提到“aks”“自动缩放”“VPA”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 计划在华北建一个生产 AKS 集群，帮我做 Day-0 检查清单。
say.note: 会给出含网络、SKU 选型的配置推荐。

say.text: 设计 AKS 网络，要求 pod 地址不进 VNet，还要限制出口 IP。
say.note: 会推荐 Azure CNI Overlay 和静态出口网关。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude outputs a recommended AKS cluster configuration based on your requirements, distinguishing Day-0 decisions (networking, API server) that are hard to change from Day-1 features, covering SKU selection, networking, security, observability, upgrades, and cost.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create a new AKS cluster, plan production configuration, design networking, or mention keywords like "aks", "autoscaler", "VPA".

say_en.text: Plan a production AKS cluster in North China and give me a Day-0 checklist.
say_en.note: Returns configuration recommendations including networking and SKU.

say_en.text: Compare AKS Automatic vs Standard for steady production workloads; which should I choose?
say_en.note: Analyzes control vs convenience and gives a default recommendation.

say_en.text: Design AKS networking: pod IPs not in VNet and restrict egress IPs.
say_en.note: Recommends Azure CNI Overlay and static egress gateway.
